title: 7. Resolution (Denouement): Final Touches
use_cases: Use when summarizing the final state of the story’s world and characters
Implement when concluding a narrative to provide a clear end
content:
The story’s end ties everything together, offering a clear outcome and reflecting on its themes.

- Outcome: Clear end state of the story’s world and characters. Example: In The Chronicles of Narnia, Aslan’s return restores peace to Narnia.
- Reflection on Themes: How the narrative addresses broader ideas or moral questions. Example: In Animal Farm, the final scenes reinforce the dangers of totalitarianism.
- Open vs Closed Endings: Choice between definitive closure or lingering ambiguity. Example: The open ending in Lost invites speculation, while The Great Gatsby offers a closed, bittersweet conclusion.
